newsitem.title: USA: Calif. San Onofre 1,070 MW unit at 80 pct power.
newsitem.headline: Calif. San Onofre 1,070 MW unit at 80 pct power.

text.p: The 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear power plant in Southern California was at 80 percent capacity and expected to reach 100 percent sometime on Thursday, a spokesman for the plant said Wednesday morning.
Unit 2 was shut at the end of November for regular refueling and maintenance, but the outage was extended by almost two months for unplanned repairs.
The facility's other operating unit, the 1,080 MW unit 3, is scheduled to start a 65-day refueling outage on April 12.

The San Onofre unit is 75 percent owned and operated by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, while Enova Corp's San Diego Gas & Electric Co owns 20 percent and the cities of Anaheim and Riverside own five percent.
